title: Incorrect assembly packing in `getNamespace` causes collisions
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High    **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `getNamespace` function contains incorrect assembly code that can lead to namespace collisions due to improper memory packing.  ```solidity function getNamespace(address account, address _caller) public pure returns (bytes32 result) {     assembly {         mstore(0x00, account)         mstore(0x14, _caller)         result := keccak256(0x0c, 0x28)     } } ```  **Memory Layout Analysis:**  `mstore(0x00, account)` writes 32 bytes:  - Positions 0x00-0x0b: 12 zero bytes (padding). - Positions 0x0c-0x1f: 20 byt
